title: Skyland MC
description: A shattered fantasy world in despair, only your valiant spirit can make  inhabitants happier.
body:
Skyland is a chill Modded Minecraft Server about a World Shattered by an Unknown Entity, leaving it with nothing but pieces of floating islands and cities.
V2 is released, the modpack has big mods like Create and Mekanism and the server has exclusive server-side mods to enable better gameplay.
